lessonTitle: 3. Integration by parts and by substitution
lessonTitleEnglish: Integration by parts and by substitution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Substitution: ∫ f(kx + b) dx = F(kx + b)/k + C; e.g. ∫ cos 3x dx = (sin 3x)/3 + C.
stages.headlineEnglish: Substitution: ∫ f(kx + b) dx = F(kx + b)/k + C; e.g. ∫ cos 3x dx = (sin 3x)/3 + C.

stages.headline: In general ∫ f(g(x)) g'(x) dx = F(g(x)) + C; e.g. ∫ 2x(x² + 1)⁵ dx = (x² + 1)⁶/6 + C with t = x² + 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: In general ∫ f(g(x)) g'(x) dx = F(g(x)) + C; e.g. ∫ 2x(x² + 1)⁵ dx = (x² + 1)⁶/6 + C with t = x² + 1.

stages.headline: Integration by parts: ∫ u dv = uv − ∫ v du; e.g. ∫ x eˣ dx = x eˣ − ∫ eˣ dx = (x − 1)eˣ + C.
stages.headlineEnglish: Integration by parts: ∫ u dv = uv − ∫ v du; e.g. ∫ x eˣ dx = x eˣ − ∫ eˣ dx = (x − 1)eˣ + C.

optionsQuiz.feedbackIncorrect: 🤔 Not quite. The correct answer is {correctText}.

stages.headline: Find ∫ x cos x dx.
stages.correctAnswer: x sin x + cos x + C
stages.solutionSteps: 1. u = x, v = sin x. 2. x sin x + cos x + C.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. u = x, v = sin x. 2. x sin x + cos x + C.
